name: scientific-figure-studio
title_zh: 先出科学正确的PNG，再追一张能编辑的SVG
tagline_zh: 画机制、结构、装置图时，不再让AI凭印象瞎编。先锁定一张学科校验过的位图，再让矢量稿向它对齐，两张都存本地。
tagline_en: For mechanism, structure, or apparatus figures: lock a discipline-checked PNG first, then align an editable SVG.
desc_en: Produce evidence-grounded scientific illustrations across disciplines with Codex image2. Prioritise the best scientifically correct PNG, then improve a genuinely editable SVG towards that visual standard without degrading the PNG. Save both locally with discipline-specific checks and honest fidelity comparisons. Use for mechanisms, structures, apparatus and conceptual figures; use data tools for q
why_zh: 它把「画得好看」和「画得对」拆成两步：PNG 是证据锚点，SVG 是编辑底稿。
why_en: It decouples correctness from aesthetics: the PNG is the evidence anchor, the SVG the editable draft, with discipline-specific.
limit_zh: 只认 Codex image2 生成图像；只覆盖机制、结构、装置与概念图，数据图表请用数据工具。
limit_en: Requires Codex image2. Covers mechanisms, structures, apparatus, conceptual figures only—not data plots. SVG approximates PNG visually, not.
title_en: Science-first PNG, then an editable SVG to match
